description: Adobe is integrating Acrobat, its PDF viewer, directly into WhatsApp web and Windows apps, the US-based tech giant announced on Wednesday. Now, users will be able to “review and collaborate” on PDFs directly in WhatsApp chat windows with others. This eliminates the need for users to leave the instant messaging app when they have to view a PDF file. Similarly, Adobe says, Acrobat users will not have to download to view the PDF. The latest upgrade lets users view the document within WhatsApp web and Windows apps. Moreover, they can scroll, zoom, and view PDFs the way they were designed to be viewed, the company highlighted.
title: Adobe Integrates Acrobat Directly Into WhatsApp Web and Windows App, Allowing Users to View, Highlight PDFs

description: Garmin Cirqa has been launched as the company's latest smart band. The Garmin Cirqa smart band boasts a screenless design. The tech firm says that the smart band can adapt and classify activities more accurately in the future.
title: Garmin Cirqa Smart Band Launched With a Screen-Free Design, Sleep Tracking Functionality: Price, Features

description: Google on Wednesday expanded its Gemini family with the launch of Gemini 3.6 Flash and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite. description: Chip prices may continue to rise, as a recent report suggests that TSMC will raise prices for its chipsets beginning next year. The move is expected to affect TSMC's clients, including Apple, Nvidia, Qualcomm, AMD, and Intel. With this move, the chipmaker is looking to offset rising costs for materials, manufacturing equipment and construction of new overseas chip plants. TSMC's 28nm, 16nm, and 12nm process nodes could become more expensive starting in 2027.
title: TSMC Plans Up to 10 Percent Chip Price Hike Amid Soaring Production Costs: Report
